annotations.title: AST-Level Read-Only SQL Query & Injection Safety Validator

description: Parses LLM-generated SQL statements to block DDL/DML mutations (DROP, DELETE, UPDATE, GRANT), stacked queries, and UNION/comment SQL injection payloads. Use when verifying that an agent-authored SQL query is strictly read-only before running it on a database; for screening non-SQL bash commands or general agent prompts, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'query' ('dialect' defaults to 'postgres'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (75 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

dialect.description: SQL dialect ruleset used for AST token inspection; defaults to 'postgres' when omitted.

query.description: SQL query string to parse and validate (e.g. 'SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE active = 1').

name: validate_sql_query_ast

blocked_clauses.description: List of destructive or injection SQL tokens detected.

safe_read_only.description: True when the query is a pure SELECT statement with zero injection clauses.

tables_accessed.description: Table identifiers referenced in FROM and JOIN clauses.
